expenditures.note: ⚠ A VOIDED ROW, KEPT AS THE DOCUMENT REPORTS IT. The filer wrote this entry and then STRUCK THE WHOLE LINE THROUGH with a single horizontal pen stroke running across the date, name, address and amount cells; a 900 dpi crop of the full row shows the strike clearly. The amount cell holds a lone ZERO GLYPH (a small open circle), transcribed as 0 under the repo's zero-glyph ruling with the glyph described here. It is published at its true printed position (row 16) with amount 0.00, which leaves the side's sum unchanged: rows 1-15 already sum to the printed subtotal of 4,177.47, so the filer's own arithmetic also treats this line as void. Nothing was deleted from the record and nothing was invented

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (4177.47) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4177.47) and its 'Total Contributions Received' (4177.47), and is restated at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: 5 Schedule A rows sum to 1,500.00 + 250.00 + 953.96 + 1,000.00 + 473.51 = 4,177.47 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the same 4,177.47 and is NOT summed as an increment — this is the filer's first report of the cycle (line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is a written '0.0'), so period and year-to-date coincide. The balance ladder closes: 0.0 (line 3) + 4,177.47 (line 4) = 4,177.47 (line 5); 4,177.47 - 4,177.47 (line 6) = 0.0 (line 7). The candidate's own 473.51 is INSIDE this total because he put it on Schedule A unannotated and his own subtotal counts it.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (4177.47) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4177.47) and its 'Total Expenditures Received' (4177.47), and restated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: The 15 money-bearing Schedule B rows sum to 12.82 + 473.46 + 360.28 + 576.99 + 176.00 + 491.44 + 42.00 + 300.23 + 930.00 + 38.50 + 95.75 + 12.68 + 400.31 + 134.51 + 132.50 = 4,177.47 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A = line 6. Row 16 is the filer's own STRUCK-THROUGH, zero-amount line and is published at 0.00, so the published sum is the same 4,177.47 either way — his arithmetic voids it too. TWO READINGS WERE SETTLED BY THIS SUM RATHER THAN BY THE GLYPH: row 13 is 400.31 (466.31 would overshoot by 65.90) and row 16 contributes nothing. Column B YTD prints the same 4,177.47 (first report of the cycle) and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. The two sides being equal to the cent is the filer's own design: he put in exactly the 473.51 needed to spend out to a zero closing balance.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate name 'JEFFERY DEAN SMITH' (Republican, residence city Orem); index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 listing grouped by office). Page-face Office Seeking reads 'UT. COUNTY RECORDER' — the filer's own abbreviation — agreeing with index.csv's 'County Recorder'. legacy_colAB, 4 pages, all four read full-page at 200 dpi: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by CONTENT), p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B; handwritten throughout in all-caps block capitals. ⚠ TWO REPORT-TYPE BOXES ARE TICKED, NOT ONE: both 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' AND 'Seven days preceding the General Election' carry a mark. The filing is NOT split or adjudicated — it is one report with one summary page and one pair of schedules, and both labels are recorded as printed. (This filer's OTHER 2010 report, 10/25/2010, ticks only the General box, so the June double-tick is not his standing habit.) THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither 'Yes' nor 'No' is ticked — which is an honest BLANK and never 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). The signature date is 6/14/2010 while the clerk stamped it received JUN 15 AM 11:24, which is why index.csv files it under 06/15/10 and the page face says 6/14; both are correct about different events. FOLIATION: the top-right Page/of box is left EMPTY on all three inner sheets although the Last Name and Date of Report cells are filled — a fourth variant of the ADDENDUM A4 foliation finding within this one chunk. THE TWO SIDES ARE EQUAL TO THE CENT (4,177.47 each) and that is the filer's own arithmetic: he contributed exactly the 473.51 needed to spend out to a zero closing balance, the same pattern Rodney Campbell used on his 2010 Recorder filing in this chunk (2,003.75 each), with the difference that Campbell labelled his own money '(personal loan)' and Smith labelled his nothing at all. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published this era in the clear, so donor and vendor street lines are plainly visible on pp3-4 and were reduced to city at READ TIME for contributions and DROPPED ENTIRELY for expenditures; none reaches any field or note. No contribution row on this Schedule A prints a STATE, so donor_state is honestly blank on all five.
